clue.text: Such muscles may be small in singers

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for small within the word for singers

parts.note: tenors are male singers with high voices
S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A remark that certain muscles in vocalists might be modest in size.
explanation.definitionFit: Tensors are muscles that tighten or stretch a part of the body, such as the tensor tympani in the ear.

clue.text: One may go to pot, seeing most of side on reserve

indicators.note: in a down answer one piece placed on another sits above it
most of means the last letter of the word for side is cut off

parts.note: a side is a sports team
to bag a seat is to reserve it

explanation.surface: Someone may go to ruin after seeing most of the team put on the bench.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go to pot' means to deteriorate, but here it is literal: into the teapot.
explanation.definitionFit: A sachet of leaves is placed in a pot to brew, so it literally goes into the pot.

clue.text: Suggestion from sister outside a church

indicators.note: outside means the word for sister wraps around the letter A

parts.note: a nun is a religious sister
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A hint coming from a nun standing beyond a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuance is a subtle shade of meaning, a hint or slight suggestion.

clue.text: Decorative — possibly late Norman

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Something ornate might be in the late Norman style of architecture.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornamental means serving as decoration rather than having a practical use.

clue.text: Fibre found in grass is allotropic

indicators.note: found in says the letters lie concealed within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A chemist's remark that a fibre in grass exists in several forms.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisal is a strong plant fibre from an agave, used for rope and matting.

clue.text: Architect discovered here undressed

parts.note: to have discovered something is to have found it

indicators.note: undressed means stripped of its outer covering, so the word here loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An architect has been found in this place without clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Architect in the figurative sense of originator: the person who sets something up is its founder.

clue.text: Country welcoming the man's business concession

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the country's name surrounds the possessive

parts.note: France is a country
his means belonging to the man

explanation.surface: A nation welcomes a man's commercial arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A franchise is a licence granted to run a branch of a business, a commercial concession.

clue.text: Exercises adopted by licentious escorts

indicators.note: adopted by means taken in by, so the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Fitness routines taken up by dissolute paid companions.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise a right or skill is to employ it, so exercises is a verb synonym.

clue.text: Striking play needing endless credit

parts.note: a drama is a play

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word for credit is cut off

parts.note: on tick is British slang for on credit

explanation.surface: An impressive production needs a loan that never runs out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on tick' is British slang for buying on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: Dramatic means vivid and impressive, synonymous with striking.

clue.text: White lies circulating within gang

indicators.note: within puts the mixed letters inside the word for gang

parts.note: a ring is a gang of criminals

indicators.note: circulating means going round, so the letters of lies are stirred around

explanation.surface: Harmless fibs doing the rounds among a criminal gang.
explanation.walkthrough: 'White lies' reads as one phrase; 'White' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Riesling is a grape and the white wine made from it, originally from Germany.

clue.text: A good area — and popular once more

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular, as in 'the in crowd'

explanation.surface: Praise for a pleasant neighbourhood that has become fashionable for a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: Again and once more are synonyms, both meaning a repeat of something.

clue.text: Draw companion who's out of condition?

parts.note: stale describes someone past their best, such as an athlete who has lost form
a mate is a friend or companion

explanation.surface: A puzzle asking who would draw a partner that has let fitness slip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' looks like a verb but is the noun: a drawn result in chess.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, the position where the side to move has no legal move but is not in check ends the game as a draw.

clue.text: Bill firm millions, and the Law loses love for partner in crime

parts.note: AC is the abbreviation for account, which is a bill
CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
M is the abbreviation for million

indicators.note: loses says the letter for love is taken out of the word for the law

parts.note: the police are informally called the law
love is zero in tennis, shown by the letter O

explanation.surface: A company's invoice runs to millions, and the police are missing a sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: An accomplice is someone who helps another commit an offence, a partner in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Cry from women in party rejected

indicators.note: in puts the abbreviation for women inside the turned-round party name
rejected means sent back, so the party's short name is written backwards

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party in Britain

explanation.surface: Female members cry out after their political party turns them down.
explanation.definitionFit: To bawl is to cry loudly, wailing or sobbing noisily.

clue.text: Took away bad cutters for adjustment

indicators.note: for adjustment means the letters are to be set differently

explanation.surface: Faulty blades were removed to be repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: To subtract is to remove one quantity from another, to take away.

clue.text: Ancient — and value in it is dubious

indicators.note: dubious means questionable or not to be trusted as it stands, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old object, and an appraisal of its worth that seems doubtful.
explanation.definitionFit: Antediluvian literally means from before the Flood, and so loosely means extremely old or out of date.

clue.text: Consider charm

definitions.meaning: to ... an idea is to give it thought
to ... guests is to amuse and delight them

explanation.definitionFit: Entertaining a proposal means weighing it, while entertaining an audience means delighting them.

clue.text: Caledonian school accepting books it's condemned!

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the abbreviation for school surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of books of the Bible
'tis is the old contraction of it is

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a northern school taking certain books is to be denounced.
explanation.walkthrough: Caledonia is the Latin name for Scotland; 'condemned!' only colours the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Caledonian is the poetic adjective for things belonging to Scotland and its people.

clue.text: Risk adopting American size of paper

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so the word for risk surrounds the abbreviation

parts.note: to imperil something is to put it at risk

explanation.surface: A gamble involving a US-format sheet of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperial is a traditional British paper size, about 22 by 30 inches.

clue.text: Observations about role creating divisions

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for observations goes round the word for role

parts.note: comments are remarks or observations
a part is an actor's role

explanation.surface: Remarks on an actor's role that lead to disagreements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divisions' suggests quarrels, but it means separate sections, as in a train or a drawer.
explanation.definitionFit: Compartments are separate sections into which a space is divided, such as those in a railway carriage.

clue.text: Female singer — one supporting large festival

indicators.note: in a down answer a piece supporting another sits beneath it

parts.note: a diva is a celebrated female opera singer
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A prima donna backing a big celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Divali, also Diwali, is the Hindu autumn festival of lights.

clue.text: Vacant sign seen on long grass

indicators.note: vacant means emptied of its contents, leaving only the outer letters of sign

parts.note: to itch for something is to long for it

explanation.surface: An empty placard is spotted on tall vegetation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' is British slang for an informer, not the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are slang verbs for informing on someone to the police.

clue.text: Bound to be clocked, losing minutes

indicators.note: losing says the abbreviation for minutes is dropped from the word for clocked

parts.note: to clock something is to time it with a stopwatch

explanation.surface: Something certain to be measured on the clock, but shorter by some minutes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound to be' reads as 'certain to be'; only 'Bound' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Bound in the sense of fastened with rope or cord, so tied up.

clue.text: Speech about racket of admission to ministerial office

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for speech is placed around the word for racket

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech
a din is a loud racket or noise

explanation.surface: A speech about noise relating to someone becoming a government minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ministerial office' suggests government, but here it is the church ministry.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordination is the ceremony by which someone is made a priest or minister of the church.

clue.text: Enthusiastic about inviting queen for opening bars

indicators.note: inviting means letting in, so the abbreviation for queen goes inside

parts.note: to be into something is to be keen on it
R is for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A fan of a monarch who gets to open the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: The opening bars of a song form its introduction, informally shortened.

clue.text: Girls gathering there's drink!

definitions.meaning: a group, traditionally of girls or of birds such as quail
bevvy is British slang for an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: A cry that a party of young women has some alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of young women is the collective noun sense; the drink is slang for beer or booze.

clue.text: Traveller needing fresh air in tent

indicators.note: fresh means new or remade, so these letters are formed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A camper needs some ventilation inside the tent.
explanation.definitionFit: An itinerant is someone who travels from place to place without a settled home.

clue.text: Breakfast drink?

definitions.meaning: ... bread is a staple of the morning meal
to drink to someone's health, raising a glass in their honour

explanation.surface: A question asking whether a morning beverage is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Grilled bread is a breakfast staple, and raising glasses to honour someone is the same word.

clue.text: Happy preparing nachos only, with son away

indicators.note: preparing means making up, so the letters are mixed into a new arrangement

parts.note: the word son is the part of the pool removed, signalled by away

explanation.surface: Someone cheerfully making just nachos once their boy has left.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove SON from NACHOS ONLY, signalled by 'with son away', and rearrange NACHOLY, signalled by 'preparing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Halcyon means calm and contented, as in recalled halcyon days of a joyful past.

clue.text: Unusual sort may find angle on love with theologian

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece written on another follows it

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shown by the letter O
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
to angle is to fish with rod and line

explanation.surface: An eccentric might go fishing for romance with a clergyman in tow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'angle' looks like a noun for a point of view, but it is the verb meaning to fish.
explanation.definitionFit: An odd fish is an informal term for a strange or eccentric person.
